issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: polished_andesite, stone_brick_slab, smooth_stone_slab, andesite_wall, stonecutter, chiseled_stone_bricks, stone_brick_wall, polished_andesite_stairs.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Stonecutter, the stand of half-cut blocks (chiseled stone, slabs, andesite) along the front wall and lanterns on the gate posts fill the yard well.
notes.purpose: Now clearly a mason's yard: stonecutter plus dressed and half-cut stone.
notes.roof: Same as L1: eaves overhang the long sides (warning partly a false alarm) but the gables are flush and untrimmed.
notes.life: Lanterns on posts; still no plants.
notes.depth: Long side wall and back gable still flat.

visual.summary: L1 plus the stonecutter, a stand of half-cut and dressed blocks along the front yard wall and lanterns on the gate posts; it now reads clearly as a stonemason's yard.
problems: Gables have no overhang or trim (same as L1): extend the roof one block past each gable or add verge trim.
Long side wall of the shed is still a flat stone face: add a post, beam or sill.
Reachability fine: roof slopes, ridge, a trapdoor top inside the shed (x=2, y=4, z=5..6) and a few wall-top/stair tops unreached; nothing soldiers need.
